response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM station_counts), 0) AS count_ratio FROM station_counts ORDER BY count_ratio DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count includes every registered observatory station, including stations with no telescopes.

alternatives.interpretation: Include only stations that have at least one telescope in the results and the average telescope count.
alternatives.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM station_counts) AS count_ratio FROM station_counts ORDER BY count_ratio DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;
